scope: FL1 is a boundary-flux and rare-tile COUNT estimate. CL1 is a boundary-preserving tiling bijection only when EVERY within-consecutive-group tile count is ZERO. OB1 is the exact four-label prescribed-boundary obstruction: one fine class, two coarse weak-lens classes and one erased internal crossing, with only one coarse class liftable.
clarifications: Retain O(epsilon L²+L+1) at finite scales. Discarding fixed-side-l cells meeting rare tiles costs O(l²(epsilon L²+L+1)); its boundary term cannot be dropped in joint limits. The rare-tile estimate gives no thin location band. OB1 does not refute global DC1 surjectivity or clean CL1; it blocks arbitrary local reinsertion after even one forbidden event. The discovery search was not a proof premise; both audits reconstructed the exact example by hand.
